parameters.query: UPDATE meli_leads l JOIN meli_leads m ON m.user_id = l.user_id AND m.id <> l.id AND m.status IN ('template_sent', 'in_conversation') AND m.received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(l.buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) SET l.status = m.status WHERE l.user_id = 2702850938 AND l.item_id = 'MLA2756424694' AND l.status = 'active' AND l.bot_uploaded = 0 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(l.buyer_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '') <> ''

SELECT * FROM meli_leads WHERE user_id = 2702850938 AND item_id = 'MLA2756424694' AND status = 'active' AND bot_uploaded = 0 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(buyer_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '') <> '' AND received_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE ORDER BY received_at LIMIT 100

UPDATE meli_leads SET status = '{{ $json.sid ? 'template_sent' : 'template_error' }}', sf_response = '{{ String($json.sid || $json.message || $json.error?.message || '').replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 250) }}' WHERE user_id = 2702850938 AND id IN ({{ $('Agrupar por telefono').item.json.ids_sql }})

SELECT * FROM meli_leads WHERE user_id = 2702850938 AND item_id = 'MLA2756424694' AND bot_uploaded = 0 AND ((status = 'template_sent' AND RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) IN (SELECT suf FROM (SELECT RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) AS suf FROM meli_leads WHERE user_id = 2702850938 AND item_id = 'MLA2756424694' AND status = 'template_sent' AND received_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL 70 MINUTE AND received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR) t)) OR (status = 'active' AND REGEXP_REPLACE(IFNULL(buyer_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '') = '' AND received_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) OR (status = 'template_error') OR (status = 'in_conversation' AND received_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 5 DAY)) ORDER BY received_at LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM meli_leads WHERE user_id = 2702850938 AND item_id = 'MLA2756424694' AND bot_uploaded = 0 AND status IN ('active', 'template_sent', 'in_conversation') AND '{{ $json.sufijo }}' <> '' AND RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '{{ $json.sufijo }}' AND received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY received_at
UPDATE meli_leads SET status = 'in_conversation' WHERE user_id = 2702850938 AND id IN ({{ $json.ids_sql }})
